holds: New formed pier crossings require their own structural/fabric detail: cold X11315/Z2725, hot X10100/Z2945 at Y2550.

terminal.materialScope: This is an explicit exposed, removable apparatus-connection comparison below the insulated backbone. R25 is not a silently reduced R37 backbone. Native fitting, guard, touch-temperature, condensation and receiver duties remain unqualified.
adverse: The washer stem meets the existing valve reaction arm at its authored support contact. Actual saddle/fitting shape is required; negative geometric distance is not a free collision exception.

reactionSupport.contact: Each open key bears on its own lower union hex. The central shaped opening is occupied by the matched union, not a solid plate through a pipe. Fit and rate both contact faces; no torque through the sink top or unsupported copper.
reactionSupport.rackConnection: The rackLink ends exactly atY1165 and meets the post and existing middle-arm return on their south face. They share a bolted/welded connection territory, not overlapping independent solids. The existing rack must receive the added force/torque.

preliminaryForceCase.basis: Authored conservative250N vertical plus50Nm wrench comparison; steel properties are minimum design inputs, not an identified product certificate. Qualify actual torsion, welds, keyed contact and rack/anchor load path before this service method is issued.

reactionSupport.loadPath: Union body → removable open reaction key → front cantilever → common cross rail → existing independent rear rack. Remove lower feed/reaction assembly before underframe retirement; upper caps and H0 remain.

tool.scope: One rotating spanner and hand; positive independently fixed reaction keys replace an unproved simultaneous second handheld spanner. Actual hex fit, torque and captive-nut stroke remain matched-component qualifications.

hotIsolation.orientation: Vertical pipe with horizontal stem facing north; independently supported below the working wheel.
hotIsolation.scope: H0 stops the hot lower branch independently of the cold U0 lobby cut. Replacing H0 itself requires upstream domestic-store isolation and controlled inventory discharge, not merely closing H0.

receiver.scope: The530 limit is transverse between two longitudinal rails, not a square throat. Keep cross-bracing below the350 lowest-part plane, with25 clear; locate actual upper lands and anti-tip capture before crew release.

head.pickup: Keep the existing four-legged frame on its seats. Capture the complete top independently against fall and pitch before the four head screws release. Head feet/fasteners/pickup remain IAS occurrence qualifications; this change provides reachable pipe breaks and a larger explicit moving package.

drains.teeScope: The final elbow becomes an explicitly bounded three-port fitting. Its50mm box includes the feed turn and downward drain; no fictitious takeoff from a fillet vertex is assumed.

controlledDrain.method: Before first nut release, close U0 and H0, prove stopped/zero-pressure flow and vent locally. Drain one isolated branch at a time through its capped, independently supported local drain into this removable floor receiver. Close the drain before emptying; retain the normal2L witness as a different duty.
controlledDrain.noCredit: No unattended burst capture, automatic response, electrical safety certification or draining of the domestic vessel into10L.

native.shoeMethod: Place the captive rear and front half-shells from their opposite normal sides with30mm opening. TheirR12 cavity approaches the bareR11 tube monotonically without crossing it. Join at the tangent-trimmed seam; then jack the already caught carrier1mm upward so the curved metal saddle bears. The two perpendicular elbow directions prevent escape without friction credit.
native.setup: Close, pressure-prove and drain first; cap the drains, seat the carrier on both catches, fit the captive half-shells with the low removable control tools and take up the metal contact before any union nut moves. The pans remain in place. Branch cartridges leave before I0 capture installation.

catch.geometry: Open-west/open-top C cheeks flank the20mm carrier crossmember, with2mm native side and back fits. A bearing plate carries its lower face; an8mm captive axial key enters the10mm backplate8mm to retain it. Withdraw20mm wholly inside the hollow crossmember before lift. The rear handoff bar sits≥30mm forward of the cage and cannot rise into the bearing plate.
catch.control: A recessed front M8 screw draws the captive key through a10mm control bore at the carrier-bar/crossmember junction; a75mm shaft/60mm T-head driver works from the front. The rod stays inside the16mm hollow and the tool leaves before movement. Open/closed hard stops expose a positive witness, not an assumed spring latch.

native.oneGripDuringActuation: Each qualified front grip alone carries the full156.96N comparison while the other hand draws one key; the other catch remains bearing until the second key is clear. Re-engage both grips before the85mm lift.
native.actualFitDuty: Execute the matched half-shell, key, jack and native2/5mm fits with±0.5mm component placement. These bounded native fits are distinct from the25mm architectural body/tool comparison.

handoffYoke.method: The primary holds both front grips at the doorway. FromXaxis+600 the helper inserts the separate yoke65mm into two100mm sockets, closes two captive8mm pins and verifies both witnesses before taking the load. The yoke is absent during station release. Its farther-east grips and central arms clear the receiving columns; an unextended rear bar would trap the hands behind those columns.

A positive witness is required before the second hand releases. One rear grip remains bearing during each closure.

handoff.method: The helper waits in the already checked plant work position during release. Once the primary holds the cartridge at the finished doorway, the helper follows the corrected ordinary plant path to the rear grips. Both bear before the primary releases; primary then withdraws to8830/3830 before the helper moves west. The protected cross door remains closed; no worker passes it.

receiver.loadPath: Carrier rear tabs enter two indexed open-front guide columns, bear at1065 and receive two independent positive keepers before either hand releases. Legs/unions remain above the850 frame; the pressure mouths are not supports. Main/branch tab locations use separate keyed index positions within the400×650 footprint.
receiver.staging: One cartridge occupies this anchored first-rest field at a time. Onward restrained bench transfer must be completed and the empty receiver verified before another cartridge follows; this packet does not authorise unbolting or carrying an occupied frame. I0 work therefore requires both branch cartridges transferred onward first. No frame is parked in the plant lobby or its ordinary route.

carrier.contact: The strut end enters a positive welded shoe lug withinR35 and overlaps its lower outer shell; no detached tangent weld or pressure-tube clamp friction is credited. Actual matched copper contact and joint execution remain qualification duties.

forceCase.scope: Both catches, the complete carrier, both grips and each guide/keeper must independently sustain the bounded load case. Actual welds, torsion, saddle contact, native mass/CG, anchor/core and returned leak/pressure performance remain component/installation qualification; the calculation supplies a force demand, not a catalogue rating.

sequence: Prove the appropriate upstream cut and local zero pressure; drain controlled inventory. Close dependent terminal cuts and keep the charged-vessel safety connection intact.
Remove the locally declared insulation, fit the closed metal carrier and positively engage both independent wall catches. Lower-body reaction keys remain connected to the wall rails.
Back off both captive nuts completely with the checked sectors while the two catches bear. Account for the full60mm backoff; do not load an unsupported pressure tube.
Take both qualified front grips. Withdraw the catch keepers only after a witnessed load transfer; lift85 to25mm complete flat-seat separation and60mm tab/cage separation.

Carry west to the doorway handoff. The second worker approaches from the plant after the first has cleared the lobby, takes both rear grips and positively bears the module before the first lets go. The first withdraws to8830/3830 clear of the WC, court and closed protected-cross door; only then does the second carry west and lower onto the receiver.
Close both independent receiver keepers before releasing hands. Reverse the controlled sequence for return, restore insulation and test before normal water service.
unclosed: Selected union full mating shape, nut backoff and lower-flat reaction fit must meet the authored envelope;60mm catalogue body length alone does not prove60mm disengagement.

Native carrier saddles/keeper fit, maximum mass/CG, hand rating, wall-core anchors, pipe-support contacts and first-rest steel/retention need the specified matched-component qualification; the authored native sections, strokes, hard seats and control paths are already explicit.

drain.retainedLowPockets: DU/DP cut above their retained900mm low routing. That lower pocket is kept sealed/capped during cartridge work; the controlled drain is not a claim that every low tube is empty. Full removal requires the low-point spool released directly over a receiver after pressure proof. D0 reaches the600mm source low leg; D1 reaches the700mm common-return low leg.
drain.method: Each capped small branch has its own manually controlled drain and downward metallic spout atZ200 above its named receiver. Close/verify the upstream cut, vent and drain in≤5L batches, closing before emptying; an unknown site-pipe inventory is not assumed to fit one pan. Do not open a union under pressure.
drain.plantCondition: Empty and prove the domestic vessel/connected inventory through its dedicated admitted drain before cold-bridge or plant-stop intervention. B0/P0 closure alone is not a300L drain result; relief remains connected whenever charged.
drain.scope: Pans are removable controlled-maintenance receivers and visible drip witnesses. No unattended30L/min burst, automatic shutoff, floor waterproofing or safe electrical wetting is credited.

entry.boundary: B0 is independent owner-side isolation in the Boundary Service Lodge; provider location, frost, flood level, movement and lawful site route remain DPL/MAT conditions. This relocates the physical water entry, not a ventilation inlet.

station.support: All six fixed union ends use independent keyed collar/reaction supports from the solid east pier, not the radiator, sleeves, removable pans or pipe below another union. Nominal30×20×3 comparison arms join shaped keys continuously to the retained wall rail; the main arm is raised15mm and its north approach shifted25mm to clear P0 transport; complete anchors and rail sections must satisfy the bounded force case and changed STR interface.

firstRestTrial.status: NOT_ACCEPTED: a prepositioned frame blocks the obvious handler stance; object clearances do not establish captured lowering.

holds: Retain native union disengagement/backoff, independent counter-holds and supported release; axes alone do not prove mating surfaces.
The complete cylinder-side socket, tail and stand must leave the eccentricR425 cart before the cylinder moves; the old retained-tail proof was for a595 mm case.
The independent T&P/manifold first-release duty remains. A cold union must never isolate safety relief from a charged vessel.
Ordinary head height is an explicit2000 mm comparison, not universal anthropometry. Handling equipment, actual mass, grips, forces and final receiver still need a complete arrangement.
